exercises.name: Easy Bar Hip Thrusts
exercises.description: Lie on your back on a bench/ball or the floor with easy bar on your hips, lift hips towards the ceiling, squeezing glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Leg Flutters
exercises.description: Lie on your back. Keep legs straight and alternate small, fast kicks while bracing your core. Lower back stays pressed into floor.

exercises.name: Leg Side To Side (Windshield Wipers)
exercises.description: On your back with legs together and lifted. Slowly lower legs side to side under control to hit the obliques.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.description: Seated with torso leaned back and feet up or down. Rotate ribcage side to side. Keep shoulders down and core tight.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.description: Alternate elbow to opposite knee with controlled rotation. Extend the other leg long and low.

exercises.name: Static Leg Raise (6 to 12 inches)
exercises.description: Hold both legs off the floor at a fixed height while keeping ribs down and lower back braced.

exercises.name: Stir The Pot
exercises.description: Forearms on ball in plank. Make small circles without letting hips sag. Keep glutes and core engaged.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Slams
exercises.description: Lift ball overhead with tall posture, brace ribs, then slam straight down using hips and lats. Reset quickly.

exercises.name: Battle Rope Slams
exercises.description: Powerful double arm slams to the floor. Sit into hips, brace core, and keep shoulders packed.

exercises.name: Battle Rope Waves
exercises.description: Alternating or double arm waves. Smooth cycles while maintaining athletic stance and neutral spine.

exercises.name: Heel Touches
exercises.description: On back with knees bent. Crunch side to side reaching to touch heels. Short controlled range.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: High plank. Drive knees toward chest with quick rhythm. Keep hips level and shoulders stacked over wrists.

exercises.name: Boat Pose
exercises.description: Balance on sit bones with legs lifted and spine long. Chest open and core braced.

exercises.name: Rollouts on TRX or Ball
exercises.description: From kneeling or plank, reach arms forward to extend and then pull back using lats and core without hyperextending.

exercises.name: Pikes with TRX or Ball
exercises.description: From plank with feet in straps or on ball, lift hips to form a pike. Control return to plank.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.description: Sit hips back and down with neutral spine, knees tracking over toes. Drive through midfoot to stand.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.description: Step back into a lunge. Front shin vertical, torso tall, drive through front heel to stand.

exercises.name: Forward Lunge
exercises.description: Step forward and lower under control. Push back to start using the front leg.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Forearm or high plank. Straight line from head to heels, glutes squeezed, ribs down.

exercises.name: Walk Out Isometric Rope Hold
exercises.description: Walk out from the machine holding arms straight at chest height under tension. Brace and hold.

exercises.name: Wood Chops
equipment: cable or band or med ball
exercises.description: Rotate from high to low or low to high using hips and core. Keep arms long and shoulders packed.

exercises.name: TRX Row
exercises.description: Keep body rigid, pull chest to handles. Squeeze shoulder blades without shrugging.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.description: Elbow under shoulder, hips stacked. Hold a straight line from head to heels.

exercises.name: Chest Pulls
exercises.description: Horizontal pull pattern. If you intended reverse fly or cable row, select grip and path accordingly and keep ribs down.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.description: Pull rope toward face with elbows high and out. Focus on rear delts and mid traps.

exercises.name: Power Pulls
exercises.description: Explosive high pull with rotational finish. Keep core braced and control the eccentric.

exercises.name: Chest Press on Ball
exercises.description: Bridge hips, upper back on ball, press dumbbells from chest to lockout with wrists neutral.

exercises.name: Chest Fly on Ball
exercises.description: With back on ball, open arms with slight elbow bend then squeeze chest to return bells over chest.

exercises.name: Snow Angels (Laying or Standing)
exercises.description: Arms sweep out and up like making a snow angel. Keep ribs down and neck long.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Press overhead with ribs stacked over hips. Finish with biceps by ears and no low back arch.

exercises.name: Curtsey Lunge TRX
exercises.description: Cross back step with TRX support. Keep front knee tracking and hips square.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge to Explosive Knee
exercises.description: Step back to lunge then drive up through the front leg to an explosive knee lift.

exercises.name: Bulldog/Bear
exercises.description: Start in a bear plank with knees hovering above the ground. Engage your core and move forward and backward in small controlled steps, keeping hips low.

exercises.name: Scissors
exercises.description: Lie on your back with legs extended. Alternate lifting one leg at a time in a scissoring motion, keeping your lower back pressed to the floor.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch with Stability Ball
exercises.description: Start in a plank / push-up position with your shins on a stability ball. Engage your core to pull your knees toward your chest, lifting your hips off the ground, then slowly return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Sky Touches
exercises.description: Lie on your back with legs raised vertically. Reach your hands toward your toes in a controlled crunch, lifting shoulder blades off the floor each rep.
